title: The Weeping Colossus
text:
Half-sunk in a still pool, a Lumari face as tall as a keep weeps [crystal]light[/crystal] into the black water. Letters older than any kingdom ring its brow and ask one thing:

[amber]"What is kept only by giving it away?"[/amber]

choices.label: Answer: "A memory."
choices.outcome: "A memory," Vesper says. The colossus closes its eyes, and its light pours into her instead. For a breath she remembers a city of glass she has never seen.

choices.label: Catch its tears
choices.outcome: Ilse cups the falling [crystal]light[/crystal] and hums until the weeping slows. The stone sighs. Something grateful settles behind her eyes, and stays.

choices.label: Pry out the crystal
choices.outcome:
Brannoc climbs the cheek and wrenches the crystal loose. The colossus does not scream. That is worse.

What it held floods into him, [crystal]cold[/crystal] and enormous.

choices.label: Bottle a tear
choices.outcome: A tear of light, stoppered in a flask that once held cheap wine. It hums against the hip like a second heartbeat.
